assets.notes: The horizon land by day (Sangram, 5 Sep, with a reference photograph: 'create such beautiful horizon … see the detailing on the mountains'). Shown in the sky view only in the review state (artPending) until Sangram approves; on approval the chosen file ships as assets/gen/land-day.png. Check in situ: the skyline must sit on the true horizon line, seams at N/E/S/W must be invisible, the night tint must not bury the foreground.
